result.fundName: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan

insights: Mirae Asset Large Cap Fund - Growth Plan marginally outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 0.84% (14.50% vs 13.66%).
Beat the benchmark in 72.3% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Large Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 0.89 vs benchmark 0.69, Sortino 1.19.
Benchmark-like risk shape: beta 0.96, volatility within 2% of the index.
Positive alpha of 3.81% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.86).
Drawdown profile is similar to benchmark (-19.26% vs -20.58%).
Rolling return range spans 11.26% to 18.12% (6.86 pp spread) — consistency score 83.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
